metadata.description: A browser-native DOM audit and purge agent. Accepts raw HTML, returns purged HTML with byte and node telemetry.

agents.name: purge_html

function.description: Deterministic HTML transformer. Strips inline styles, unwraps redundant divs, removes deprecated tags, and reports exact byte/node reduction.

html.description: Raw HTML payload to audit and purge.

agents.instructions: Call this agent with an HTML string. It returns the purged HTML and telemetry. No API key required; runs entirely client-side.

tools.name: purge_html
tools.description: Exposed endpoint the runtime invokes to run the Necessity Engine transform.
tools.instructions: Call this tool with an HTML string to get purged HTML and telemetry.
